title: persistent energy price rise could hurt consumption by autumn ecbs lane says 2026 09 11
text:
WEXFORD, Ireland, Sept 11 (Reuters) - A persistent rise ​in energy prices ‌could hit personal consumption in the euro ​zone before ​the end of the ⁠year but remains ​an uncertain issue ​for policymakers, European Central Bank Chief Economist Philip ​Lane said ​on Friday.
"What we see now ‌is ⁠a rise in energy prices, if that persists, maybe ​that ​will ⁠hit consumption in the autumn, ​and so ​that ⁠remains an uncertain issue," Lane told ⁠a ​conference in ​Ireland.
